name: playwright-cdp-esg
description: Playwright Chrome tests that start an ESG Selenium session and connect over CDP

scripts.test:stress: ESG_STRESS_TEST=1 ESG_CPU="${ESG_CPU:-4096}" ESG_MEMORY="${ESG_MEMORY:-4096}" ESG_IDLE_TIMEOUT="${ESG_IDLE_TIMEOUT:-300}" ESG_WORKERS="${ESG_STRESS_WORKERS:-8}" ESG_STRESS_TESTS="${ESG_STRESS_TESTS:-8}" ESG_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS="${ESG_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS:-180000}" ESG_STEP_PAUSE_MS="${ESG_STEP_PAUSE_MS:-0}" playwright test --grep @stress-cdp
